name: Pretty Devil Paradise ~Millium Makai Dakkan Shirei!~
original_name: PrettyDevilパラダイス～ミリオム魔界奪還指令！～
source:
Millium is a probationary devil, who suddenly fell from the sky. Sota, the main character, and Millium has been peacefully living together since then. One day, a new student joins his class and a pretty girl moves to the next door. As a matter of fact, these two girls are succubi and their mission is to bring Millium back to their world. Well, will Sota be able to keep his lovelove life with Millium...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108001413/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010684]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
米莉欧姆是一名见习恶魔，某天突然从天而降。此后，主人公奏太便与她平静地共同生活。一天，班里来了一名转校生，隔壁也搬来一位漂亮女孩。实际上，这两个女孩都是魅魔，任务是把米莉欧姆带回魔界。那么，奏太还能否继续与米莉欧姆甜蜜恩爱地生活下去…？
